test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"could."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Could"** is the correct option to fill in the blank number 3.
 
• **"Could"** is a modal verb that indicates possibility or ability.
 
 
• **Example**: *She **could**__ sell me those flowers.*
 
 
 
• In this context, using **"could"** implies that the action is possible but not guaranteed.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

A beautiful spectacle for anyone to __behold__ would be the crowds that throng to see the Indian cricket team playing, whether it be in India or in other parts of the globe. This __undoubtedly__ is the occasion where the spirit of oneness is all pervasive. India with all its diversity __**could**__ be seen either rejoicing or moaning depending on the sway of the game ______ (4) ______ watched. Unity in diversity is ______ (5) ______ in all its glory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, "shouldn't", **would imply that the action is not advisable or recommended.
 
• **Option 3, "won't",** would imply that the action is impossible or unlikely to happen.
 
• **Option 4, "shan't", **is an outdated contraction of "shall not" and is not commonly used in modern English.
